qualification.limitation: Residual severity does not identify bad correspondence versus localization or model error without real truth; lattice quantum does not bound detector localization.

scope: Saved metadata only. No image payload/stat reads, detector/matcher calls, numerical-subject imports, unvisited refinement or second exhaustive hypothesis search. Independent integer coefficients/residuals verify only selected seeds and actually visited refinements. Entire held-out populations are descriptive, not physical cause/truth. Global seed optimality is not independently reenumerated; pinned loop/key coverage, seed census and actual observer hashes provide partial assurance.
